events.explanation: Goalie outlet reaches the carrier. This is possession, not a scoring chance.
Carrier advances; the middle passing opportunity opens.
Receiver controls the pass. Possession sequence complete; no shot or goal is awarded.

scene.note: Fictional explicit-unit outlet/carry/pass scene; named assignments and seeded contests. A received pass is not a shot or goal. No clock, fatigue, continuous movement or NHL probabilities. F1/F2/F3/D1/D2 are local scene addresses; roster positions and phase duties are separate.
